notes: SYNTHETIC frontend fixture for the D3 act-unavailable state (docs/04 Part D, D3). NOT listed in cases/index.json and never shown to a judge. Mirrors the Ennore attribution gap: 'attribute' is absent from acts_available while 'trace' is present, so the Attribute stage must render greyed with a why-tooltip and the app must skip it in the flow (Trace primary action -> 'See what really happened' -> Verify). One oil detection is present so D1 (no-spill) never triggers; origin.abstain is false so D2 never triggers. Assets (bounds/sar/detections/particles/origin/verification) copied from case-000. The real D3 case is Ennore (Master Plan Part 3), which is also missing 'detect' (decision D16) and is blocked on upstream bundle files.
